behaviors.description: Unique, remote-qualified, missing and ambiguous operation lookup.
expected: NULL remote finds unique ref, remote qualifier disambiguates duplicate ref, ambiguous and missing matches return NULL with GError.

behaviors.description: Initial zero transfer rate followed by sustained positive rate.
expected: First-second rate samples are zero; paced sustained download exposes nonzero bytes-per-second.

behaviors.description: Resolved B metadata and old A permissions.
expected: Exact B commit, full new and old keyfiles, and NULL unsubsetting at ready.

behaviors.description: Paced transfer progress values and monotonic counters.
expected: Changed status and estimating flag readable; percentage bounded; positive transferred bytes monotonic and start time stable.

behaviors.description: Both ready decisions with resolved fixture refs.
expected: Refusal fails before execution and preserves empty state; acceptance deploys exact commits.

behaviors.description: Unauthenticated pre-auth inspection and abort decisions.
expected: Resolved refs require no token; refusal precedes ready and execution; acceptance succeeds.

behaviors.description: Execution order, empty skipped updates, and signal thread.
expected: Non-skipped resolved list matches execution; unchanged update resolves empty; callbacks run synchronously on run thread.

behaviors.description: Per-ref size getters match immutable reference commit metadata and uninstall zeros.
preconditions: fixture.sizes[version][fullref] prepared by reference ostree from xa.installed-size and xa.download-size
expected: Each app/runtime operation size equals its own reference-prepared literal, excluding dependency sizes; uninstall sizes are zero.

behaviors.description: Retained operations, installation, progress status and live cause graph.
expected: Owned results survive transaction destruction; borrowed cause graph is inspected only while transaction lives.

mappings.rationale: Lookup queued uninstall with NULL remote, then add a reinstall from a different remote and verify each qualifier; NULL remote ambiguity and missing remote/ref must all return NULL with GError. Inspection preserves installed A.
Paced 1 MiB payload produces samples during first second that must have zero rate and subsequent nonzero rate samples, with successful exact B deployment.
Prepared A and B differ in network permission. At ready compare entire old/new metadata keyfiles and exact B commit; C asserts NULL subpaths; abort preserves A.

Paced 1 MiB required payload generates repeated changed signals; C checks readable status and boolean estimating, bounded percentage and stable monotonic start time during positive transfer, monotonic bytes; Python requires payload-sized byte count and successful B deployment.
Both callback decisions, exact resolved refs, absence of execution and installed-state checks.
Retained ready list pointer order equals new-operation order, no skipped elements; all-skipped update is empty. Every execution callback checks run thread and active run lifetime.

Feed per-ref immutable xa.installed-size and xa.download-size literals collected by reference ostree at preparation into C assertions. Each app/runtime operation must match its own literal, excluding dependencies; both uninstall sizes must be zero. No target size API supplies expected values.

Owned installation and operation list inspected after releasing transaction; runtime cause identifies app while alive. Actual allocating status result retained across later callbacks and object release, compared to saved bytes and freed.
